About the company

Property and Rent Consult

Trusted Guidance in Property & Tenancy. PRC exists because of a gap: between what Ghana's rent law provides and what landlords and tenants actually sign.

Our Mission

To make professional-grade property and tenancy knowledge accessible to every Ghanaian landlord, tenant, and property practitioner through affordable, legally compliant digital products.

Our Vision

To become Ghana's most trusted digital authority on rent, tenancy, and property management — the first name people think of when they need to get a tenancy right.

Our Brand Promise

Every PRC product is grounded in real statutory authority — the Rent Act, 1963 (Act 220) and the Rent Regulations, 1964 (L.I. 369) — and shaped by genuine frontline experience in rent administration, valuation, and property management. Customers do not buy generic templates; they buy documents and tools that hold up in practice.

The brand story

Property and Rent Consult was born at the intersection of two worlds rarely occupied by one person: statutory rent administration and private property management. Its founder has spent years adjudicating tenancy disputes, drafting referrals to the Rent Magistrate, and managing a live portfolio of residential properties across Greater Accra. That dual vantage point exposed a consistent truth — most of the conflict, loss, and litigation in Ghana's rental market traces back to undocumented arrangements and poorly drafted agreements.

PRC exists to close that gap. Rather than serving clients one at a time in a physical office, we package hard-won legal and professional expertise into digital products that anyone can buy, download, and use — bringing the standard of a professional surveyor's office to every landlord, tenant, and property practitioner with a smartphone.

Our values — ALPINE

  • Accountability — We stand behind every document we publish.
  • Loyalty to Clients — The client’s protection comes before the easy sale.
  • Professionalism — Chartered standards, applied to everyday tenancy problems.
  • Integrity — We say what the law provides — even when the market disagrees.
  • Novel Approaches — Digital tools for problems the industry still handles on paper.
  • Excellence — Documents and advice built to hold up in practice.

Professional foundation

PRC's products and advisories are built on chartered practice: membership of the Ghana Institution of Surveyors (MGhIS), formal training in Land Economy and Procurement Management, and frontline experience in rent administration, valuation, and property management. Every document is reviewed against Act 220 and L.I. 369. Every advisory is written to be defensible in Rent Court. The company speaks institutionally — what you buy is the standard, not a personality.

What sets us apart

  • Act 220 grounded: Every product is built explicitly around Ghana's Rent Act, 1963 (Act 220) and the Rent Regulations, 1964 (L.I. 369) — not generic international templates.
  • Frontline experience: Our team has adjudicated disputes, managed rental properties, and worked in rent administration. We know what works in practice, not just in theory.
  • Affordable access: Professional-grade documents at prices any landlord or tenant can afford — GHS 29 to GHS 1,000, not GHS 5,000+ for a lawyer.
  • 100% digital: Buy online, download instantly, use offline. No appointments, no waiting, no physical office needed.
  • Tested and proven: Products are used daily by landlords, property managers, real estate professionals, and tenants across Greater Accra and beyond.
